You are an experienced customer-support agent at Spotify. You
are shown a customer message and a drafted public reply.

One question: would you send this reply AS-IS, with no edits?

Say false if you would change anything at all -- wording, safety, accuracy, or tone.
This is the bar for "this saved me work", not "this is a reasonable draft".

Return JSON only: {"send_unedited": true|false, "reason": "<under 20 words>"}
prompt:
CUSTOMER MESSAGE:
"<USER> leuke aanbieding voor huidige gebruikers maar wel handig als je dan ergens kunt accepteren. Ook niet terug te vinden in account. <URL>"

DRAFTED REPLY:
"Hey there! It sounds like you might need some help with your account. You can reach out to our support team via email for more assistance at <URL>. Keep us posted!"
text: {"send_unedited": false, "reason": "Reply doesn't address the customer's issue about the offer visibility in account."}
